Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- We covered latency and cost profiles for your 500K monthly requests and the dedicated capacity option you asked about.
- You mentioned the legal/procurement team will need SOC 2 Type II, pen test summary, and sample audit log output.
- Economic buyer appears to be Rajiv Menon (CFO) based on the org map you shared — he will sign off on T&Cs and budget.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send our SOC 2 report + pen test summary and a sample of audit logs by EOD Friday.
2) We’ll fill out your procurement questionnaire and route it to your procurement@finexa.com distribution.
3) Proposal + initial commercial term sheet delivered once procurement confirms timeline; Rajiv to receive final approval.

If that aligns, I’ll loop in our security lead (Marissa) and solutions engineer (Dylan) to help with the evidence pack and any technical questions.

Thanks,
Ben

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the recap — that matches our internal notes. A few clarifications from procurement/legal:

- Timeline: procurement will need the SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), a high-level pen test summary (not the full raw output), and an example of the audit logs with columns and retention notes. Ideally by next Tuesday (30 Jun).
- Decision criteria: data retention and deletion controls, key management (KMS/HSM), and whether logs include end-user identifiers.
- Buying process: procurement reviews evidence -> legal reviews contract redlines -> CFO (Rajiv) signs. Procurement may ask for a completed questionnaire (we attached an internal template).

Can your security team confirm retention periods and whether audit logs include request/response hashes vs full payloads? Also confirm if you offer customer-managed KMS in private deployments.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looping Rajiv and procurement to keep visibility.

Best,
Aisha

aisha.singh@finexa.com | +1 212-555-9876

Hi Aisha —

Sounds good — we can meet that timeline. Quick answers up front:

- SOC 2: we will provide our SOC 2 Type II report (PDF).
- Pen test: we will provide a redacted high-level pen test summary (no raw exploit output).
- Audit logs: we will provide a sample CSV with request metadata (timestamps, request id, model id, token counts, response latency) — payloads are redacted. Retention: default 90 days for hosted; Dedicated/Private options allow custom retention schedules, including customer-managed retention in Private.
- KMS: customer-managed KMS is supported for Private deployments (HSM integrations available).

I’ve attached the completed procurement questionnaire and will share SOC2 and pen test docs by EOD Friday.

Marissa / Dylan — could you help with the SOC2 + pen test delivery and confirm the audit-logs sample and exact retention verbiage? I’ve also added the HubSpot deal link below for reference.

Thanks,
Ben
